selected.assay: bulk RNA-seq of ipsilateral (ischemic) striatum, rat tMCAO model, day 35 (S4.16.p1, FIG5)
selected.design: 2x2 factorial randomised groups: vehicle alone (n=3), vehicle plus PE (n=4), NPCs alone (n=3), NPCs plus PE (n=4) (S2.1.p1, FIG5 legend)
selected.sample_inclusion: 14 animals, one sample each; independent animals, no repeated measures
selected.primary_estimand: Effect of postoperative physical exercise on striatal gene expression after stroke: vehicle plus PE vs vehicle alone (Fig 5A); exercise effect within grafted animals: NPCs plus PE vs NPCs alone (Fig 5D)
planned_contrasts: vehicle+PE vs vehicle (FIG5 A; S2.4.p2; paper DEG count not stated, heatmap only)
NPCs alone vs vehicle (FIG5 B; not an exercise contrast)
NPCs+PE vs vehicle (FIG5 C; exercise confounded with graft)
NPCs+PE vs NPCs alone (FIG5 D; exercise effect in grafted animals; DEG count not stated)
selected.paper_method: HISAT 2.0.5 alignment, DEGseq 1.18.0 pairwise DE (S4.16.p1); GEO data_processing instead says HTSeq counts + DESeq2

paper_threshold.source_locator: S4.16.p1 (no DEG cutoff stated); GEO data_processing states q<=0.05 and |log2 ratio|>=1 (DESeq2)

selected.paper_results: Fig 5 heatmaps and top GO terms only: PE alone up-regulates cholinergic synaptic transmission / acetylcholine metabolism genes; NPCs+PE vs NPCs enriches neuronal excitability, learning and memory, dopamine signalling, adenylate cyclase activation. No DEG counts or named genes in the text.

decisions.reason: S2.1.p1 defines the four randomised groups; FIG5 legend gives the four RNA-seq comparisons and group sizes (4/4/3/3); S4.16.p1 gives HISAT2 + DEGseq with no threshold. The exercise estimands are Fig 5A (PE vs vehicle) and Fig 5D (NPCs+PE vs NPCs). Fig 5B is graft-only and 5C mixes graft and exercise.

checks: DA.p1 names GEO GSE190355; series pubmed_id = 35030322
series has one supplementary file, GSE190355_fpkm.anno.xls.gz (gzipped TSV of FPKM plus annotation), 14 sample columns for 14 GSMs
GEO data_processing mentions a raw-count matrix, but no count file is deposited (series SOFT lists only the FPKM file; sample supplementary_file_1 = NONE)

decisions.reason: The matrix is the only supplementary file of the paper's own accession and has 14 sample columns, matching the 14 GSMs and the paper's 4+4+3+3 design. Ownership of the file is clear; per-sample identity is the alignment question.
